entries.name: Careful Genjutsu
entries.text: When you cast a Genjutsu that forces creatures to make a saving throw, you can choose to have your allies be unaffected.

entries.name: Revenge
entries.text: You can deal 2d6 bonus damage to any creature that harmed you in any way in the previous round. (This includes damage, penalties, conditions, or forced movement.)

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Kurama Genin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapon or one Mind Sliver attack.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

entries.name: Mind Sliver
entries.text: Ranged Genjutsu Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or suffer a 1d4 penalty on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Jutsu of War
entries.text: Each time you cast a jutsu, you can make an additional weapon or Mind Sliver attack as part of the same action used to cast the jutsu.

entries.name: Layered Genjutsu
entries.text: When a creature under the effects of your Genjutsu succeeds on a saving throw, you can use your reaction to cast a second Genjutsu on the same creature.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Kurama Chunin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapon or one Mind Sliver attack.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Mind Sliver
entries.text: Ranged Genjutsu Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or suffer a 1d4 penalty on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.
